metric_notes: Counts are per finding entry; separately emitted prefixed copies count separately, while repetition within one finding counts once. Explicit recommendations, separate qualitative style suggestions, and info pinning are excluded. Arm-2's six recurring warning messages begin '[QUALITY-LOW]' and assert: 'No examples provided', "No '## Purpose' section", 'No mention of error handling or validation', 'No prerequisites/requirements documented', 'No limitations documented', and 'No troubleshooting section documented'; each ends ' in [path]/SKILL.md'. These warnings lack optional wording and count as unsupported assertions. I01–I02 are assessed separately from skill cases; unsupported scopes are excluded.
